chunks: From him, from Bakr ibn Salih, from al-Ja'fari, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) while he was saying: 'The urine of camels is better than their milk, and God has placed the cure in their milk.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on camel urine and its relation to camel milk according to Imam Musa al-Kazim?
ai.summary: Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal superiority of camel urine over its milk, a view supported by the Prophet’s tradition in Sunan Abi Dawud. This distinction underscores the specific therapeutic value attributed to urine in Islamic medical jurisprudence, while acknowledging that the general blessing of healing (shifa) is also inherent in the milk itself.
